standard_prerequisites.name: Perfect descent
standard_prerequisites.use: Descend K and K^prime; preserve perfectness of the convolution.

standard_prerequisites.name: Smooth diagonal perfectness
standard_prerequisites.use: The diagonal kernel at level i is perfect.

core_obligations: Descend K and K^prime to some level i; the convolution kernel descends and its pullback is the diagonal kernel over S.
The level-i diagonal kernel is perfect; after increasing i, perfect descent identifies the descended convolution with the level-i diagonal kernel.
The same argument with K and K^prime reversed gives the second identity.
proof_roadmap: Descend, compare the two perfect kernels level-wise, and finish with perfect descent; mirrored for the reverse composition.
difficulty_reason: Perfect complex descent along affine limits with a composition identity verification in both directions; fully displayed.
